live_trace.note: Task 11d ran orig/g.exe under qemu+gdb with RandSeed pinned in a patched COPY and logged every Random draw at the `retf 2` of 0f78:1165. All eighteen draws below were observed at the catalogued site with the catalogued n; none was contradicted. Per-draw verdicts are each draw's `live_trace` field; the observed stream, the guards the runs passed and the full comparison are in data/rng_trace.json. Method and addresses: docs/re/rng-trace.md. TIER LABELS AND TRACE CITATIONS ONLY -- no flow claim in this file was re-derived or rewritten.

address_convention.rule: file_off = 0x18d0 + (seg - 0x1000) * 16 + off; a 1000:XXXX code address is file offset 0x18d0 + XXXX
address_convention.rule_scope_warning: the `- 0x1000` term above is a shorthand that holds ONLY for segment 1000 citations. For every citation in this file whose segment is not 1000 -- all the 0f78:, 0eed: and 0f16: runtime entry points (0f78:114b, 0f78:06c6, 0f78:0772, 0f78:081e, 0f78:0825, 0eed:01c2, 0f16:031a) -- the mapping is file_off = 0x18d0 + seg * 16 + off. Worked example, byte-verified: 0f78:114b -> 0x18d0 + 0xf78*16 + 0x114b = 0x1219b, which disassembles to the 32x16 high-take `mul word [ss:bx+0x4]` pair and `retf 0x2` -- i.e. Random itself. Applying the segment-1000 shorthand to a far target lands 0xf780 bytes short.
address_convention.note: `bytes` is the literal opcode encoding at `at`, so a drift is checkable without a disassembler. Read that as the check, not as a blanket assurance: the first version of this file claimed every address had been re-disassembled before being written down, and review round 1 falsified that -- class_389c.consumers cited 1000:13dc (an identically shaped lookup on the ENEMY class at [0x3952]) for what is 1000:1a36. Corrected in fix wave 1; every address touched or added in that wave was disassembled from an aligned instruction start, never from a byte-scan hit.

random.convention: mov ax,<n> / push ax / call far -> result in ax, 0 <= result < n
random.semantics: RandSeed := RandSeed * $08088405 + 1; Random(n) = (RandSeed * n) >> 32 (high-take, NOT a modulo). Already established, see docs/re/rng.md and data/rng_vectors.json.

site_scan.method: byte scan for `9a 4b 11 78 0f` over the whole image
site_scan.completeness: established from flow -- the encoding is fixed-length and the scan is byte-exact, so no call of this form IN THE RANGE can be missed. That is the scan's only claim, and it is not a claim about the stream: draws reached through calls OUT of the range are invisible to it and are enumerated in `nested_routines` instead. Draws 17/18 at 1000:25fe are exactly that case, reached by the near call at 1000:7fed -- the first version of this catalogue missed them because it read this sentence as covering the whole turn. The out-of-range reach is bounded by enumeration: the preamble contains exactly two near calls (1000:b3a7, 1000:b3b7), the church exactly one (1000:7fed), and the mage and the level-up routine 1000:2526..1000:28c4 contain none.
